mappings.assertion: TestLifecycleDecisionConstantsKeepWireSpelling compares every LifecycleSafeAction and LifecycleEffects constant with an independent literal (continue, stop, requery, retry, correct_input, none, unknown, committed) and the two field-diagnostic actions with models.FieldDiagnostic*. Negative proof: changing the retry constant to 'retry_' failed it and was restored. No A3 call of WrapLifecycleError, NewLifecycleOutcome, lifecycleRequestError, retireFailedLifecyclePreparation or newDiagnosticLifecycleError passes a raw action or effects literal (AST scan of internal/ops: zero hits in the A3 file list), and no A3 file assigns one to a carrier feeding them or to a SafeAction/Effects field (grep of every quoted decision value across the A3 file list: the only remaining hits are the constant declarations and other vocabularies such as runtime-input bound, assessment dependency outcome and the mode_change.go goal-complete label).

TestLifecycleRefusalKeepsTextAndStringSafeDetails (refusal text 'mark-blocked: STATE_CHANGED (safe_action=requery): lost race', INVALID_INPUT text, plain-string safe_action/effects/outcome in SafeDetails, JSON wire fields) and TestKernelSafeDetailsCarryPlainStrings (AgentAuthorityError and LifecycleSprintChangedError SafeDetails hold plain strings). Negative proof: dropping the string() conversion in agent_authority.go failed the latter and was restored.

The A3 lifecycle oracle (TestOracleLifecycleReceipts and the L1-L14 drivers) compares json, human and state.yaml against goldens unchanged by this task; models.LifecycleOutcome and FieldDiagnostic fields stay strings and the wire values are pinned by the spelling and SafeDetails tests.

The lifecycle receipt and preparation tests (TestLifecyclePreparationRequiresAuthenticatedGenerationTurnover, TestPreparationFromRetiredGenerationDoesNotBlockAnotherActor, TestRetiredPreparationClearsCheckAndCompletionForAnotherActor, ownership_lifecycle_test.go) run unchanged under go test -race ./internal/ops/ ./internal/commands/ ./cmd/liza/.
test target (go test ./...) runs the ops, commands, cmd/liza and A3 oracle suites including the new tests; lint, test-e2e and the race run are mandatory with it.
